# Spray Foam Receptionist — Missed Call & Call Coverage Resource for Spray Foam Contractors

> An educational resource for spray foam insulation contractors on the cost of missed calls and
> how to fix call-handling gaps. This site is not itself an answering service — it connects
> contractors with guidance to help them evaluate the right call-coverage solution.
